name: SM_Car_LuxA2
units: metres, Unity axes (x right, y up, z forward); origin = ground, wheelbase midpoint; the tyres touch y = 0 (checked per LOD in contact)
material: Hanoi/Vehicle: _BaseMap T_CarBody.png (albedo, paint baked neutral grey), _DataMap T_CarBodyData.png (R rough, G metal, B lamps, A paint mask -> albedo x _PaintColor), normal T_CarBody_N.png (tangent space). Body UVs in [0, 0.8]^2, rim tile u,v 0.8-1, tyre u 0.8-1 v 0.6-0.8

rig.hierarchy: FBX is flat: SM_Car_LuxA2_Rig > Body_LODn, Wheel{FL,FR,RL,RR}_LODn (origins on the axles). Unity: Steer{FL,FR} pivots on the front axles hold the front wheels (rotate about Y); every wheel spins about its local X.
